title: The tame and the wild automorphisms of an affine quadric threefold
publication: Journal of the Mathematical Society of Japan 65(1), 299-320 (2013)
portions_inspected: Introduction and Section 2.1: elementary polynomial automorphisms of the quadric arise from triangular matrix operations with coefficients in fixed coordinates.
role: Primary context for the explicitly written quadratic-preserving shears. Neither the tame/wild classification nor a generation theorem is used as a proof input.
